descFull: ESP32-S3 firmware: Wake-on-LAN from Telegram or ntfy (no VPN needed), Tailscale/Headscale gateway, and Ethernet or 4G/LTE uplinks that keep IoT devices online. Selective LAN-to-Tailnet forwarding, subnet routing, Home Assistant and remote recovery.
